text.에이전트가 읽을 참고 파일(md·html·텍스트). 실행 폴더에 복사돼: A reference file for the agent to read (md, html, text). It's copied into the run folder and passed on.
text.에이전트 실행 폴더에 둘 상대 경로입니다. 비우면 본문 파일 이름을 씁니: Relative path to place it at in the agent's run folder. Leave empty to use the content file name.
Change this when the agent needs to find the file at a specific path.
File type (MIME). Leave empty to use the type of the content file.
text.이벤트가 일어날 때 실행할 명령. 실행 여부는 실행 백엔드·설치자 설정이: A command to run when an event happens. Whether it runs is decided by the execution backend and the server administrator settings.
Name of the event to hook. Names not in the list can be used too.
text.hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령)을 다른 시점에 걸고 싶을 때 바꾸: Change this to hook the hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) to a different moment.
text.hook을 걸 대상입니다(예: 도구 이름 Bash, Write|Edit): What to hook (e.g. tool names Bash, Write|Edit). Leave empty for everything.
Fill this in to hook only certain tools.
Command to run. It receives the event content as JSON.
Change this to change what the hook does (a check script and so on).
Maximum time to wait for the command. Leave empty to use the execution backend default.
Raise this when the command takes long and gets cut off.
text.에이전트에 주는 지침 문서(공용 CLAUDE.md, 에이전트별 지침, 프: Instruction documents given to agents (shared CLAUDE.md, per-agent instructions, prompt snippets).
text.지침의 제목입니다. 먼저 붙은 같은 제목 지침을 '바꾸기'로 대체할 때: Title of the instructions. Used to replace earlier attached instructions with the same title with 'replace'.
text.공통·팀 설정에서 붙은 같은 제목 지침을 대체하고 싶을 때 맞춰 적으세요: Write the same title to replace instructions with that title attached in the common or team settings.
text.먼저 붙은 지침의 뒤(append)에 붙일지 앞(prepend)에 붙일지: Whether to add it after (append) or before (prepend) the instructions attached earlier.
text.이 지침을 다른 지침보다 먼저 읽히게 하고 싶을 때 prepend로 바꾸: Change this to prepend to have these instructions read before the others.
When on, adds a '## Title' line before the content.
text.본문 파일 대신 쓰는 짧은 지침입니다. 둘 다 있으면 본문 파일이 우선입: Short instructions used instead of a content file. If both are set, the content file wins.
Use this to write short instructions directly, without a file.
text.에이전트가 쓸 MCP 서버(stdio·http·sse). 비밀은 secr: An MCP server for agents to use (stdio, http, sse). Secrets only as secret:// references.
text.에이전트가 보는 MCP 서버(외부 도구 서버) 이름입니다. 도구 이름 앞: Name of the MCP (external tool server) server the agent sees. It prefixes the tool names.
text.같은 이름의 서버가 겹치거나 도구 이름을 알아보기 쉽게 하고 싶을 때 바: Change this when servers with the same name clash or to make tool names easier to recognize.
text.명령을 실행해 잇는지(stdio) 주소로 잇는지(http·sse) 고릅니: Whether to connect by running a command (stdio) or by address (http, sse).
Change this to http or sse if the server is served at an address (URL).
Command that starts the server. Used when the transport is stdio.
Change this when the way to start the server changes.
Arguments to pass to the command.
Change this when you need to pass options to the server.
text.서버에 넘길 환경 변수입니다. 비밀 값은 secret://이름으로만 적습: Environment variables to pass to the server. Write secret values only as secret://name.
Fill this in when the server takes values such as keys or tokens from environment variables.
Server address. Used when the transport is http or sse.
Change this when the server address changes.
Headers to add to requests. Write secret values only as secret://name.
Fill this in when the server requires an authentication header.
text.특정 경로의 파일을 다룰 때 적용할 지침(.claude/rules 형식): Instructions applied when working with files at certain paths (.claude/rules format).
text.이 규칙을 적용할 파일 경로 패턴입니다(예: src/**/*.ts). 비: File path patterns this rule applies to (e.g. src/**/*.ts). Leave empty to always apply it.
Fill this in to use this rule only when working with certain files.
Rule file name (without extension). Leave empty to use the resource id.
text.본문 파일 대신 쓰는 짧은 규칙입니다. 둘 다 있으면 본문 파일이 우선입: Short rule used instead of a content file. If both are set, the content file wins.
Use this to write a short rule directly, without a file.
text.지침으로 넘길 때 본문 앞에 붙이는 문장입니다. {paths}는 경로 패: Sentence added before the content when passed as instructions. {paths} is the list of path patterns (e.g. src/**).
Folder inside the run folder to place the rule in when passed as a rule file.
text.SKILL.md와 부속 파일(스크립트·참고 문서)로 된 skill. 실행: A skill made of SKILL.md and supporting files (scripts, reference documents). It's copied into the run folder and passed on by the execution backend.
text.에이전트가 보는 skill 이름(폴더 이름)입니다. 비우면 리소스 id를: Name of the skill the agent sees (folder name). Leave empty to use the resource id.
Change this to make the skill name the agent calls easier to recognize.
Allowed and denied tool lists and the command allow list.
Tool names the attached agents may use.
Add tools here to give the attached agents more tools.
Tool names the attached agents may not use.
Add tools here to keep the attached agents from using them.
Commands the attached agents may run.
Add commands here when the attached agents need to run them.
Do not use the any type.

codes.resource.unsafe_path: The path must be a relative path inside the run folder.
